## Grok Imagine API

Grok Imagine is an image generation and image editing model by xAI, available on the Venice API as `grok-imagine-image`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### Grok Imagine API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grok-imagine-image` | Generate | Private | $0.03 / image |
| `grok-imagine-edit` | Edit | Private | $0.03 / edit |

### Grok Imagine specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | xAI |
| Released | Apr 9, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 2:1, 19.5:9, 20:9, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 1:2, 9:19.5, 9:20 |
| Prompt limit | 7,500 characters |

### How to use the Grok Imagine API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "grok-imagine-image"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "grok-imagine-image",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
